name: momentum-crypto-rw8-symtsm-pure-v1
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-28, DRY-RUN ONLY, NOT EXECUTED. RW8 trial 469 -> 470. Exact live RW7 no-brakes control except ONE design: symmetric TSM on the existing 14-day return / 30-day MA hourly kernel. maxShorts=4, shortEntryPct=-5 with price below own MA, shortExitPct=2 (or loss of below-MA condition), shortStop fixed 0.04 mirrors the long stop. Same vt35 sizing, 120h cap and confirmed same-tick reentry. No shortRegime/shortUniverse gate. Source: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen (2012), Time Series Momentum, https://w4.stern.nyu.edu/facdir/lpederse/papers/TimeSeriesMomentum.pdf (symmetric own-return direction and volatility scaling, NOT a replication of its 12-month/monthly model). Horizons, thresholds, stops and cap are the owner's live-kernel constraints, not parameters fitted here or attributed to that paper. Data/universe/order/asOf/costs/folds/capital/acceptance unchanged. Missing signals/data or physical margin limits can still prevent entries. No backtest, live activation or model-key change.
